_README: MACHINE-READABLE ROSTER VERDICTS (phase 179). The screening verdicts used to live ONLY as prose
in qa-boss/anchors/MK-FINAL-WAVE2-SCREEN.md, so no tool could read them and every filesystem-based
survey missed them. That failed FOUR times: nurikabe-shield (caught mid-write), kira-foxflare (a
full kit was written and committed for a REJECTED character), umbra-jelly (agent stopped), and
drake-glaive (agent stopped). The prose ledger even carried a warning about this exact failure.
The prose file remains the reasoning of record. THIS file is the machine-readable index of it,
and qa-boss/may-i-write-kit.mjs is the guard that reads it. Keep them in sync: when you add a
verdict to the prose, add it here in the same commit.
status: OK          = screened, viewed, cleared to write a kit
REJECTED    = do not write a kit; reopening is a DECISION, not a fresh measurement
TIM         = gated on Tim's ruling; do not write a kit unilaterally
UNVIEWED    = numbers are clean but nobody has LOOKED. 50% of numerically-clean plates
fail the view, so this is NOT permission — view it first.
Anything absent from this file is treated as REFUSED by the guard, deliberately: 'not in the
reject list' must never be readable as 'approved'.

kira-frostveil.why: Viewed phase 184. BAKED MIST/VAPOUR rendered into the character — her paired sai are translucent ICE with visible vapour streaming off the blades. That is the banned effect class rendered into the plate, the exact ground that rejected Ghast Flail (baked smoke/mist around the base). It also explains her 11.49 translucency, the highest of the unviewed set: the WEAPONS themselves are see-through, so they will fringe badly and may partially key away. Body is also quite open to camera.

skeleton-nodachi.why: DOUBLE COLLISION, viewed phase 184. WEAPON: nodachi and odachi are the SAME weapon (大太刀), so it collides with the SHIPPED satoshi-odachi — the exact ground that rejected Tengu Naginata (same weapon as raiju-naginata). CREATURE: skeletal undead, colliding with lich-scythe. Secondary: bare bone limbs, individual finger bones and split lower-leg bones are all thin fringe-prone struts, and p99 13.2 was already the highest of the unviewed set.

ningara-silk.why: Viewed phase 184. COSTUME IS THE DECISIVE GROUND, and it is not technical: a sheer lace lingerie bodysuit, stockings and high heels — a pin-up render, tonally incompatible with a roster of armoured samurai, knights and creatures. Also, independently: the sheer lace is GENUINELY translucent across the whole torso (this is what the measured 7.67 will-fringe was detecting — real see-through fabric, not a green-dominant confound); high heels give no stable ground contact for the feet-flat beats every kit requires; and the spear collides with the SHIPPED sora-yari.

kitsune-tanto.why: THE BLOCKER DID NOT MATERIALISE — needs a canonical-look ruling, not a re-screen. Its PLATE carries a live yellow-green blade glow (5.28% emissive, the highest in the roster, and the character the "kitsune blocker" class is named after). But the 13 RAWS ON DISK DO NOT REPRODUCE IT: the raw frames show plain steel before any keying, so the model never rendered the glow. Consequence, all measured phase 183: the clips key CLEANLY (soft fur tails crisp, blade intact and not carved into, residual greenExcess mean -35, p99 0, 0.00% hot), and they agree with their own plate BETTER than accepted clips do (idle .920/.917, strike_a .937/.938 vs lich strike_a v3 ACCEPTED at .902/.905; ko .370/.347 is expected since he collapses). So they are technically shippable. THE ONLY OPEN QUESTION IS A DESIGN ONE: the plate shows a glowing blade and every clip shows plain steel, so the canonical look is inconsistent between the still and the animation. Tim rules on which is canonical. NOTE these raws predate the 3-role start/end/image transport, so a RE-FIRE today would pin the glowing plate at f0 and might reintroduce the hazard the existing raws happen to dodge.

jorogumo-kusarigama.why: NEW CANDIDATE from the previously-unscreened MYTHIC tier, screened + viewed + padded phase 185. Distinct archetype (jorogumo spider-woman, four extra spider legs, kusarigama chain-sickle) with NO roster collision — nothing shipped is a spider or wields a chain-sickle. Raw art was 96% fill / 34px margins (unusable, normal for input/MK FINAL/); PADDED to 1536 gives fill 68%, L212 R212 T468, all margins >=200px. Keys with margin (opaque 12.56, emis 0.25, p99 5.9). Translucency 5.98 inspect-band with grnDom only 8.9 — so it is REAL mild see-through from the cyan web membranes between arm and torso, not a green confound. KIT MUST: bound the four spider legs (they own the LEFT edge) and the sickle tip (owns the RIGHT edge, and the chain is a long extending prop — the classic containment hazard); pin the cyan web membranes and cyan limb rim-light as fixed-brightness, fixed-opacity features. Span ceiling 1.38x is tight, same class as elara-frostplate. WATCH: hydra-flail is also a chain weapon, but sickle-vs-weight and spider-vs-hydra are distinct enough that this is a watch, not a collision — and hydra has never shipped.

Zephiron.why: Viewed phase 186. BAKED LIGHTNING — brilliant blue arcs crackle around BOTH staves, plus glowing eyes. Kitsune-blocker class. ⚠ THE SCREEN MISSED THIS: it measured only 1.11% emissive and filed it in the mild "has a lit feature, pin it" band, because lightning is THIN FILAMENTS and a percentage-of-subject measure under-weights thin bright features badly (compare Godflame_Liu at 14.09% for a head that is simply on fire). The number is not wrong, it is the wrong statistic for this shape of defect.

Wight Spear.why: Viewed phase 186. DOUBLE COLLISION, the same pattern that rejected skeleton-nodachi: the spear collides with the SHIPPED sora-yari (the Tengu Naginata ground), and undead/wight collides with lich-scythe. NOT a baked-emissive reject — its 3.36% is pale blue FROST RIME on the armour, correctly rim-light class, so the screen was right to route it to a look. Secondary: the spear is fully extended across the frame (prop-EXTENDED, would need padding), and the art reads noticeably lower-fidelity than the rest of the roster.

Stormlord_Rex.why: Viewed phase 186. TRIPLE REJECT. (1) BAKED LIGHTNING — bright yellow electrical arcs crawl the full length of his spear. That is literally the kitsune-blocker class the standing loop prompt names as disqualifying. (2) FRONTAL plate — chest square to camera, both feet forward: no side to mirror, the ir41-kasa-oni failure. (3) spear collides with the SHIPPED sora-yari.

Captain_Nyra.why: Viewed phase 188. SETTING INCONSISTENCY — a naval officer in a modern WHITE DRESS UNIFORM with medal ribbons, thigh straps and knee boots, carrying a cavalry sabre. The roster is consistently feudal-Japanese / dark-fantasy (ronin, oni, lich, gargoyle, undead knights). Note this is NOT a too-anime complaint — ir37-pink-tessen is anime-styled and shipped — it is that MODERN MILITARY DRESS is a setting element that appears nowhere in the roster. Secondary: very long streaming hair plus a long ribbon owning the left edge, the shiro-gale consistency/containment class. Technically she is the CLEANEST plate in the whole pool (0.08% emissive, good side profile facing screen-right, clear arsenal), so this is a TASTE call and Tim can overrule it — it is recorded as a judgement, not a defect.

Yokai Kama.why: Viewed phase 188. DOUBLE COLLISION. (1) ANTLERED FIGURE — an antlered wood/forest yokai, colliding with the SHIPPED thorn-warden. That is the exact recorded ground on which Antler_Mire was rejected. (2) TWIN KAMA — a kama IS a sickle, colliding with jorogumo-kusarigama (chain-sickle), cleared and kitted phase 185-187. Setting fit is otherwise excellent. TECHNICAL NOTE, and it is a narrower claim than the disproven alpha-holes one: he is green-dominant on a GREEN plate, which by itself is harmless (the keyer is a border-seeded flood, so interior green is never a candidate) — but the THIN GREEN LEAF SPROUTS off his vine-wrapped blades are protrusions SURROUNDED BY BACKGROUND, so they ARE reachable by the flood and would key away. That is the real shape of the green-on-green hazard.
